XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Occasionally, during acceleration, the engine fault warning light flashes.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | SENSOR | REVOLUTIONS | P0302 | P0303 | P0300 | ENGINE | INCREASING | SPEED | ACCELERATING | FLICKERING | INTERMITTENT | YELLOW | YELLOW | LIGHTS UP | LIGHTED | TIMES |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Engine speed sensor

  • Fault: The vehicle’s engine fault light flashes sporadically during acceleration

  • Errors detected by the on-board diagnostics:
    • P0300 (Misfire in unspecified cylinders – Fault)
    • P0302 (Misfire in cylinder 2 – Fault)
    • P0303 (Misfire in cylinder 3 – Fault)
  • Cause: Faulty engine speed sensor

• Intervention: Check that the engine speed sensor is working properly and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The faulty component is accessible from the underside of the vehicle, on the passenger side, located on the crankshaft pulley, near the radiator.
